notes: The flip gate for vesper-chrono (aspect ci flip-gate --, SH6 lane 1,
#1396; this crate's lane: SH6 lane 14, #1409). The port-backed package
links @vesper/chrono (vesper/) and its flipped modules forward to it; the
compiler links the Rust seed copy (seed/), which keeps the Rust until
self-hosting Stage 2. Part 7a flips the CoreSight formatter
Differential: 20,000 generated formatter captures in both modes (ETR
frames and TPIU with full-frame syncs), with ID changes, null/flush/trigger
and reserved IDs, random auxiliary bits, truncated and extended tails,
single bit flips and small output budgets, against the Rust deformatter.
ABBA formatter: deformat a 64 KiB ETR buffer of two interleaved sources
with padding, a source switch every four frames or so.
